entries.c84ec823bd7509de: With 'Rather than the largest company, be the best company' as its company motto and basic philosophy, the New Medium-Term Management Plan, with fiscal 2026 as its first year, sets two basic policies, 'fundamental structural reform to transform the management structure' and 'building an integrated manufacturing and sales business model that unites planning, manufacturing and sales', and states that it will take on the challenge of becoming an 'Only 1 Shirt Maker'. It states that it will narrow its business scope to business wear and will consolidate production sites and optimize inventory levels.
entries.d15adf330084331e: In the department store channel, the custom-order provision system is a differentiating factor, and the company's share of custom-order shirts reaches 82%.
